name: trazum
description: Prompt optimiser: cut the cost of your AI calls without losing quality.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @trazum/core && npm run build -w @trazum/cli
scripts.test: npm run test -w @trazum/core && npm run test -w @trazum/cli
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @trazum/core && npm run typecheck -w @trazum/cli && npm run typecheck -w @trazum/web
scripts.verify: npm run build && npm run test && npm run typecheck && npm run build:web
